name: Revenant Caves
accessNote: The Revenant Caves sit in the Wilderness (levels 17-40), entered from the Wilderness or via the Ferox Enclave shortcut. The caves are singles-plus combat, so a dwarf multicannon cannot be placed and player killers can attack you while you fight a revenant. Safe-spotting is not wiki-documented and treated conservatively as false. Bring only low-risk gear and a one-click escape teleport.
